questions.question: If it was Tuesday on 22 July 1969, then what will be the day of the week on 6 August 1985?
questions.solution:
Given: 22 July 1969 is Tuesday.

Now, 1969 to 1985 = 16 Years.

In 16 years, 4 Leap year and 12 ordinary years.

Total odd days from 22 July 1969 to 22 July 1985 = (4 × 2) + (12 × 1) = 8 + 12 = 20 days.

And, 20 days = 20/7 = 2 week and 6 odd days.

So, 22 July 1985 was = Tuesday + 6 = Monday.

Now, 22 July 1985 to 6 August 1985 = 15 days, 15/7 = 2week and 1 odd day.

Therefore, 6 August 1985 = Monday + 1 = Tuesday.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of '?' in the following equation, if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

63 ÷ 3 + 14 × 7 - 16 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation: 63 ÷ 3 + 14 × 7 - 16 = ?

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘-‘ and ‘×' and '÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 63 × 3 - __**14 ÷ 7**__ + 16 = ?

⇒ __**63 ×**____** 3**__ - 2 + 16 = ?

⇒ __189__ - 2 __**+**____** 16**__ = ?

⇒ __205 - 2__ =** 203.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

11 ÷ 4 + 8 × 2 - 1 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table:

Given equation: 11 ÷ 4 + 8 × 2 - 1 = ?

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘-‘ and ‘×' and '÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 11 × 4 - __**8 ÷ 2**__ + 1 = ?

⇒ __**11 × 4**__ - 4 + 1 = ?

⇒ __**4**____**4**__ - 4 __**+ 1**__ = ?

⇒ __45 - 4__ = **41**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/ subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

13 - 15 - 7 and 9 - 11 - 5
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number + 2nd number) **÷ 4** = 3rd number.

Given,

13 - 15 - 7

⇒ (13 + 15) ÷ 4

⇒ 28 ÷ 4 = 7.

And, 9 - 11 - 5

⇒ (9 + 11) ÷ 4

⇒ 20 ÷ 4 = 5.

Similarly, **Option 1) 16 - 24 - 10**

**⇒ (16 + 24) ÷ 4**

**⇒ 40 ÷ 4 = 10.**

 Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".

questions.question: 10 is related to 17 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 50 is related to 65. To which of the following is 26 related following the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 1st number - 1 = n²

2nd number - 1 = (n + 1)2 

10 is related to 17

⇒ 10 - 1 = 9 → 3² 

⇒ 17 - 1 = 16 → 42 

50 is related to 65

⇒ 50 - 1 = 49 → 72 

⇒ 65 - 1 = 64 → 82 

Similarly, **26 is related to**

**⇒ 26 - 1 = 25 → 52 **

**⇒ 37 - 1 = 36 → 62 **

So, **26 will be related to 37**.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 2"
